messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: REDWOOD-AZ3-CPU-SATURATION
pagerduty: Page fired to oncall (policy: az-outage)

sara-nguyen: seeing increased error rates from east-us-az3, 504s on /v1/generate
mike-liao: also high queue length on gpu-hosts-az3, spike started ~10m ago
carla: oncall, i'm digging into fleet metrics; pushing to run a drain on one node to see if it clears
sara-nguyen: FYI traffic spike seems concentrated on a few customers using streaming; could be batching spike

ryan: acked the PD page and joined. can we failover regionally? what's the risk to latency
mike-liao: we can enable failover to east-us-az1 for new requests. existing KV cache miss might increase cold latencies ~200ms
carla: starting canary redirect for 5% traffic via routing rule: set header X-Redwood-Prefer: az1

sara-nguyen: customer-impact: roughly 12% of requests in az3 are getting 504s and retry volume up 3x
oncall-rota: escalating to ENG-SRE after ack, please confirm SLA impact and notify CS
mike-liao: ENG-SRE looped in. I triggered autoscale for az3, but GPU scheduling delayed due to pod limits. manual node add in progress

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: next oncall in 2h is carla -> ryan
sara-nguyen: noted. carla, can you coordinate with CS for known customers? I'm drafting status update
carla: will DM CS. also running quick config rollback to previous model instance build (suspect memory leak)

mike-liao: rollback complete on 3 hosts, OOMs stopped on those, overall 504 rate dropping to 7%
ryan: increasing failover to 25% while we stabilize. monitor p99 latency and error budget

sara-nguyen: Status page draft: 'Degraded performance in east-us-az3 caused by resource saturation; mitigation in progress — traffic partially routed to east-us-az1. Customers may see increased latency or transient errors.'
carla: :thumbsup: post once we confirm p50/p99 improving

mike-liao: p99 down from 1.8s to 1.1s after more nodes online, error rate trending lower
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident cleared (ACK -> RESOLVE) by ryan
sara-nguyen: closing thread, will follow up with RCA doc and postmortem. thanks team
ryan: thanks all — sync for RCA at 1600 UTC
